result.topic_en: The page finishes a number-theoretic construction of a prime ideal with prescribed residue symbols, then sets out a plan to show that Desargues' theorem cannot be proved from Pascal's theorem in the plane using only axioms I 1-2, II, III, by defining unique angle transfer with vertical/supplementary angle theorems.
